neighbours.label: Texas place names (cities, counties, towns, FM farm roads), peaking on the name's last piece ('Nacogdo|ches', 'Brown|sville', 'Bex|ar'); the same frames with places in other states stay quiet
neighbours.notes: Played on the Twitch letsplay stream (chat was quiet, so these are the agent's own sentences). Probes: other-state places (Boise, Spokane, Missoula, Duluth, Kenosha) stay under 0.1. Known word leak kept out of the test: 'Austin' as a person's name (Steve Austin 0.31, Austin Butler 0.38). The inverse solver found a 'June 19' (Juneteenth) leak at 0.40 and Lone Star State culture text at 0.36, so it carries a broader Texas signal that is strongest on place tokens. Ambiguous names (Victoria, Odessa) stay low.
